---
title: "Outreach"
---

In my first year at Brookstone, my goal is to connect with students in each of the school's five divisions (preschool, lower, intermediate, middle, and upper) through science outreach.

I also hope to take part in one outreach activity with the broader community. One possibility is to work with Agricolga, Brookstone's student group that works with Fox Elementary on science projects.
